reviews.disposition:
Historical27-stage episode and corrected test-tool consumer under AD36/AD42/AD43. Read runner extraction, four situation contracts, implementation/adjacent detail, all delivery/floor rows and late suite/consumer corrections. A/B frozen-build replay proves runner structural parity for its old scenarios, not the new C episode. Actual native groceries/reservation/refund, labelled meal parcels, bread consumption and uncounted remainder are bounded custody, not complete household mass/nutrition/pricing. Zero-value templates mean no established sale price, not a universal free-good economy. Gun stove/bed facts protect actual selected custody without implementing firearms.

Ordered dream/sleep observations require real guide/body/contact and selective received account; apparent dream movement does not transfer physical stock/legal state or unspoken thoughts. Changed pending-save validation reads the command's actual declared contact/co-location policy while preserving anchor support, not a general unrestricted dream-control mechanism. Melissa source placement/held visit and11 non-reserving lead timing annotations fix reviewed order/support, not calendar chronology or all NPC schedules. Knowing an introduction comes from the actual observation rather than loading a cast definition.

Ten-tick coalescing remains opt-in developer tooling with real engine callbacks/idle-work stop. The first six-minute sleeping-idle-record discrepancy required a meaningful progress-observation consumer, not accepting approximate parity. Corrected comparison preserves all original saved values while adding eight declared item-availability templates rather than stock.235.84/254.87/62.15-second observed timings under concurrent load are not controlled/project-wide speedup proof or player batch controls. The original full27-stage route and final corrected-bundle focused travel proof have distinct identities; unchanged1160 compiled sources/pack and one actual empty-destination guard change support their stated reuse, not a final-bundle full-route replay.

The initial4924/4925 failure was a real empty-route/context regression; restored early return fixed it. The corrected full4924/4925 still timed out one worker, whose unchanged isolated103.10-second test passed. All4925 cases have qualified distributed evidence, not a green monolithic full command or completed pre-commit gate. Under-load browser30-second timeout and later120-second/77-second retry are retained harness/load evidence, not fresh gameplay or performance guarantees. Positive UI feedback/ritual questions are not human played-through acceptance. Later D examination owns that next boundary. Full receipt read recovered56–end after truncation, with no linked private source/pack/runtime/log/image/save inspection or new execution.

reviews.classification: historical repaired consumer / retained donor palette / acquisition/read distinction / exact-source index
reviews.disposition:
Full N01–N27/F4–F8/C6–C13/D3/V3–V5 breadth review under AD32/AD35/AD36. Preserve18 mods/nine packs as27 additional donor questions rather than a five-favorite cap, full-world commitment or accepted build sequence. Page/repo/tree indicates author description/access/pinned file inventory, not semantic runtime review, edition compatibility or installed/played status. Earlier19 samples remain their own read scope. Later N28–N45 and61-artifact acquisition, already actually read B494/B495, supersede acquisition state without proving full deep reading of this catalog.

N01–N09 retain recognition versus eligibility, research beyond points, particular infused carriers, actual helper/custody, local aura/environment, prepared spell powder, typed spell composition, equipment/servant support and living substrate. N10–N18 retain heat/speed/pressure operating conditions, source-specific ports, geography/process preparation, bee breeding versus productive hive, decreed local offers, real worker-request routing, trial partial/full settlement and actor/instance loot scope. Funding/conservation in Bountiful is the proposed receiving design, not verified donor code. Terraria-style survival pressure or Minecraft maintenance/tick rules are not automatically YAIR defaults.

N19–N27 retain visibility versus capability/rights, production-by-method recognition, constrained starts, alternate chemistry sourcing, coherent initial kit, actual cross-system dependencies, expedition-production joins and Monifactory mode differences. Ultimate Alchemy sparse metadata, MeatballCraft image-heavy descriptions, Biomancy WIP guides and Divine Journey unread payload remain limited. Classic/modern ports, original Nomifactory/CEu/Monifactory and Cuboid editions are not interchangeable. The source page/title alone does not fill a graph or actual resource law.

Recovered ChatGPT labels/widgets without URLs remain source gaps. FTB Quests flexible/minimum/exclusive/startable strings support a design lead, not every runtime edge; GTNH ignoreNBT/standalone-book claims remain unverified. Old premature-scripting advice is agent proposal, not user prohibition. C6–C13 give concrete retained-material, capacity/support, environment, helper, funded-request, trial, production-method and starting-kit choices through incumbent owners. Catalog inclusion selects none for implementation. Full body read recovered1–42 after truncation; no fresh website, archive, script, source class or native test. Old depth priorities remain recommendations under current canon/desktop/save authority, not new acquisitions or runtime dependencies.

reviews.classification: historical repaired consumer / retained donor palette / acquisition/read distinction / exact-source index
reviews.disposition:
Full G6–G10/L01–L12/B1–B7/T1–T3/A1 scout chronology under AD32/AD35/AD36. Distinct-world systems plus portable growth is the requested comparison, not merely a universe label on a prestige loop. Official descriptions/design articles are advertised procedure/premise evidence, not played quality or exact carryover. Multiverse Loot Hunter is the scout's strongest advertised match, Multiverse Idle demo/coming-soon state is historical, and the MUDs' linked worlds/guilds do not prove all destinations give freely collectable independent powers. RetroMUD's timeout/excerpt remains lower assurance, not source absence. Jumpchain/GURPS/Your Chronicle/Theory of Magic were already known, not newly discovered gaps.

Twelve filename/size/PDF-header checks establish local candidates at that date, not reading, edition equivalence, machine-wide absence or current possession. This reconciliation reads the public report only and opens no PDF, so no hidden/extracted PDF text is used. Any future actual PDF read needs the current screening/reading workflow. The later acquisition-follow-up supersedes earlier missing-title inventory for named Voices of the Datasphere/Rifts Megaverse Builder, not a full new title roster, chapter read or gameplay adoption. Named book/tabletop source details stay with the catalogue/private owners.

The Strange's retained identity/stat pools versus changed foci/body/gear is a useful contrast, not a rule that all acquired powers stay simultaneously executable or must be suppressed in YAIR. Traveling, rebirth/continuation, actual source acquisition and useful home consumer remain different tests. Publisher/authors/editions matter: Monte Cook Games is a publisher,5e/Cypher Planebreaker differ, Invisible Sun is separate, GURPS listing is not an actual download. Torg reality axioms are an optional model, not mandatory foreign-power loss. SRD availability is not setting-prose/asset/game licensing clearance.

A1's digital trials, existing L03/L07 reading and B-priorities are research recommendations, not present purchases, game launch, full-source/implementation assignment or a final source roster. Preserve person/carrier/learned-versus-granted/return/home-use questions without forcing all worlds through one retention model. All original closing/acquisition paragraphs were recovered70–94 after truncation. No current web/store, book/page, catalogue, install, tool or private save state was independently checked.

reviews.classification: historical repaired consumer / retained donor palette / acquisition/read distinction / exact-source index
reviews.disposition:
Full exact-index/selected-method map review under AD32/AD35/AD36. Read every receipt/source/table/localization/image row, constructor locator, method span and reused-owner ending. Fresh input pins include Steam appmanifest build metadata, not a successful launch. Fresh finite type extractions differ from reused full BuildingDomain/Character/CharacterDomain/frontend bodies and copied prior frontend outputs. Failed type-name attempts remain failures; corrected commands/hashes do not turn them into additional semantic reading.183 MakeItemType and inherited350/441/55/314 tables are retained schemas/rows with expression/arity/ID validation, not evaluated runtime values or whole-class coverage.

Preserve exact item/subtype/material/tool/medicine IDs and localization/GlobalConfig references as locators into pinned private copies, not freestanding semantics. The method table spans target/material/tool selection, UI condition/quantity/confirm, backend start/check/acquire/progress/result/grade, medicine admission/locks/slots, instant application, injury/property calculations, duration and offline updates. UI list eligibility, request payload and backend actual consequence are different consumers; selection of full method bodies does not establish every nested branch, callback, actual gameplay or save/expiry behavior. Similar overload names keep separate spans rather than one merged formula.

Six original images with source captions are retained visual observations in this lane, not native clicking/persistence or proof the current installed app matches them. Own-copy versus parent-copy paths retain provenance. Hash/dirty status proves selected-byte identity and no ownership of unrelated edits, not a right to stage/share private raw C#/localization. Old payload/bottle/process/logs were not operated by this index pass; do not inherit native proof by copying. Current full-public-index review opens no private method bodies/tables/images/receipts, executes no decompiler/tool/game and adds no qualified Taiwu mechanics or YAIR implementation. The report/ingredient flow and prior tooling owners retain concrete consequence/source gaps.
